questions.title: Does the control plane carry two independent degrees of freedom, or collapse to one scalar?

convergence.reason: no fan-out growth; nothing ruled out yet

hypotheses.label: score-bias and temperature are independent axes
hypotheses.desc: MECH-063 sub-claim (i): the MECH-320 tonic_vigor score-bias axis and the MECH-313 noise_floor temperature axis route to distinct E3 softmax parameters and produce non-collinear behavioural effect vectors (rank 2)
hypotheses.basis: 777 narrowed nothing. Its self-routed collinearity label is an artifact: mean_sin_angle 0.530 EXCEEDS the 0.500 margin and C1 fell on seed-count (3/5 vs min 4) plus dispersion. The score axis's dependent variable (D_action_mass) was saturated at ceiling on seeds 11/29/37 and at floor on seed 23, so the axis had no headroom to express itself; the P0 authority gate passed only via a mean across seeds that masked two seeds individually below the effect floor. Control therefore NOT cleanly passed. Hypothesis stays alive pending V3-EXQ-777a.

hypotheses.label: tonic baseline and phasic transient are independent DOF on one readout
hypotheses.desc: MECH-063 sub-claim (ii): the MECH-313 tonic noise_floor moves the sustained baseline entropy while the SD-069 phasic_surprise_burst moves an event-locked transient on the same E3 temperature readout, with cross-legs ~0 (double dissociation)
hypotheses.basis: 779 narrowed nothing and its readiness was unmet (non_degenerate false). The substrate was NOT the problem: SD-069 was correctly wired (signal_source instantaneous_pe) and fired in every PHASIC-ON cell (burst_level_max 1.0, 5-22 event ticks). The failed phasic_fires_real_events precondition (5 vs 10) is a min across cells sourced entirely from seed 23/T1P1, which ran 19 of 900 budgeted steps. Hypothesis stays alive pending V3-EXQ-779a.

hypotheses.label: the control plane collapses to a single scalar
hypotheses.desc: the rival reading: apparent tonic/phasic and score/temperature distinctions are reparameterisations of one underlying control scalar, so no genuine second degree of freedom exists
hypotheses.basis: The rival hypothesis remains untested. 777 appeared to support it but did so via a saturated dependent variable, not via a fair test; that apparent support is withdrawn by this autopsy.

questions.title: Do the SD-068 consolidation-pipeline per-phase readouts measure content fidelity, or raw noise sensitivity?

convergence.reason: no fan-out growth; eliminations in 1 family

hypotheses.label: the SWS denoising readout tracks content fidelity
hypotheses.desc: sws_denoising_snr scores the preserved deviation-structure of injected clean prototypes, so its sigma-slope reflects functional damage tolerance rather than raw noise sensitivity
hypotheses.basis: null_slope_ratio 1.0000 (sd 2.7e-8, 95% CI [0.99999997, 1.00000001]) on 8/8 seeds -- the zero-content null arm reproduces the injected arm's sigma-slope to eight decimal places. Structural, not statistical: noise_power is identical across arms at every sigma while signal_power is 5585.7 vs 0.0, so denoising_snr_db = 10*log10(signal/noise) has a sigma-slope driven entirely by log(noise_power) and the content term differentiates away. Readiness precondition met (injected slope 0.0665 >> 1e-06) and criteria_non_degenerate true, so the control discriminated cleanly.

hypotheses.label: the NREM transfer-fidelity readout tracks content fidelity
hypotheses.desc: nrem_transfer_fidelity measures the fraction of the injected-content gap closed by the CrossModuleConsolidator pass, so its sigma-slope reflects functional damage tolerance
hypotheses.basis: null_slope_ratio 0.1445 (sd 0.00090, 95% CI [0.1438, 0.1451]), 0/8 seeds confounded, verdict stable, CI well below the 0.25 ceiling and not straddling it. The null arm's slope is ~14% of the injected arm's, so the readout is substantially content-contingent. Necessary-not-sufficient for SD-068's full 3-phase contract: this is the ONLY phase confirmed content-contingent.

hypotheses.label: the REM precision-calibration readout tracks content fidelity
hypotheses.desc: rem_precision_error scores |running_variance_after - 1/target_clean| against an injected known target precision, so its sigma-slope reflects functional damage tolerance
hypotheses.basis: The run narrowed nothing on this leg. Per-seed null ratios are degenerate at BOTH rails: exactly 0.0 on 5/8 seeds (null calibration_error pinned at the constant 998.5009992509989 with target_clamped 1.0, giving an identically zero slope) and off-scale 1801-9143 on 3/8 (null precision reference collapsed onto the 1e-3 positivity floor, so 1/1e-3 dominates). mean 1911.6, sd 3306.1, 95% CI [-379, 4203], ceiling_inside_ci95 true, confound_verdict_stable false. The 5 apparently-unconfounded seeds are unconfounded only BY DEGENERACY -- a zero slope from a saturated constant is not evidence of content-contingency. Stays alive; the observation bottleneck is the clamp saturation, fanned out as H-rem-clamp-artifact / H-rem-genuinely-content-free.

hypotheses.label: the REM null degeneracy is a clamp artifact of the step=1.0 measurement choice
hypotheses.desc: GOV-FANOUT-1 leg. The full-adoption step=1.0 linear interpolation drives calibration_error into its positivity floor / saturation constant, so the null arm cannot express a graded slope regardless of content-contingency
hypotheses.basis: Untested. Probe (AMENDED 2026-07-18T09:56:12Z, pre-queue, before any compute -- see probe_amendments): UNPAIRED-TARGET null. Point the recalibration at an INDEPENDENT positive target of the same magnitude class (ARM_NULL_UNPAIRED), unpaired with the clean target the error is scored against -- the faithful Bar et al. 2020 'same odour, no prior pairing' analog -- and retain the 778c zero-content null (ARM_NULL_ZERO) as a replication anchor. Declared null: if ARM_NULL_UNPAIRED stays railed too -- still clamping, still constant -- this leg is REFUTED and the measurement axis is eliminated from the question. The ORIGINAL step-ladder probe was retired as PROVABLY INERT: the 1e-3 positivity clamp is applied upstream of step and step cancels in the reported slope ratio, so the ladder was exactly step-invariant to 12 significant figures and would have returned this leg's declared null BY CONSTRUCTION. Adjudicating run V3-EXQ-778d (ree-v3 18c4687).

hypotheses.label: the REM calibration readout is genuinely content-independent, like SWS
hypotheses.desc: GOV-FANOUT-1 leg. The rival reading: the clamping is incidental and a de-clamped readout would still show a null slope ratio near 1.0, making rem a second content-free leg
hypotheses.basis: Untested. Probe: score the rem leg against the injected precision target directly rather than via running_variance_after, and compare null vs injected slope in common units. Declared null: if a de-clamped readout yields null_slope_ratio <= 0.25, this leg is refuted.

hypotheses.label: rem_generative_gain is a content-free transfer-function property
hypotheses.desc: GOV-FANOUT-1 leg. The attenuating generative gain (0.149, 8/8) may be a property of the rollout transfer function rather than evidence that 'correction needs an intact seed' -- which would undercut the sd_068 doc's line-221 gloss without touching the attenuation finding itself
hypotheses.basis: Untested, but motivated by an observation in the 778c manifest that sits OUTSIDE the scored C1 criteria: on seed 42 the null arm's rem_generative_gain (0.182/0.184/0.188/0.209 across sigma) is close to the injected arm's (0.165/0.166/0.172/0.190) at rem_gen_content_scale 0.0. Probe: contrast generative gain at content_scale in {0.0, 0.5, 1.0} across seeds. Declared null: if gain scales monotonically with content scale, this leg is refuted and the doc's gloss stands.
